title: Three-input sorting function
statement: For an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^3$, let $b_i$ be the bit corresponding to the sign $x_i$ for $i=0,1,2$. The function takes the value $-1$ exactly when $b_0\le b_1\le b_2$ or $b_2\le b_1\le b_0$, and takes the value $1$ otherwise.
caveat: The definition of the sign-to-bit conversion is not included, so its precise correspondence cannot be stated.
